supported_seams.name: profile-composition
supported_seams.contract: bundle layers, dedicated profile patch, home patch, explicit overlays, then telemetry; production must use an engine-owned DSH_HOME so no shared home patch participates

supported_seams.name: per-execution-shell-env
supported_seams.contract: ShellEnvRegistry.register declares owned DSH_* names and collect(execution) resolves a fresh immutable snapshot

supported_seams.name: ambient-scrub
supported_seams.contract: scrubbedParentEnv removes every ambient DSH_* and credential-shaped KEY/PASSWORD/SECRET/TOKEN name

supported_seams.name: subprocess-merge
supported_seams.contract: explicit caller environment is merged after scrubbedParentEnv for foreground, background, and terminal children

supported_seams.name: bash-collection
supported_seams.contract: ctx.shellEnv.collect(exec) is called once per foreground or background ToolExecution

supported_seams.name: bash-dispatch
supported_seams.contract: spec.dshEnv is merged last into the explicit spawn environment for run and start

supported_seams.name: powershell-collection
supported_seams.contract: ctx.shellEnv.collect(exec) supplies the same snapshot for PowerShell foreground and background ToolExecution

supported_seams.name: powershell-dispatch
supported_seams.contract: spec.dshEnv is merged last into the PowerShell spawn environment

registry_currency.registry_snapshot_generation: monotonic committed snapshot currency; checked independently at admission and never included in plugin_contract_generation
registry_currency.binding_record_generation: monotonic generation local to one root binding; unrelated record mutation cannot change it

execution_provenance.selection_stage: stable sc bootstrap before SC_DISPATCH target inspection, SC_CALLER_ROOT projection, dispatcher selection, command-specific import, credential discovery, DB/API/filesystem access, or process start; only the fixed kernel provenance inputs may be read first
bootstrap_order: resolve canonical engine-owned provenance contributor without ambient selectors
resolve native, managed, or unknown OS execution membership
refuse unknown and native DSH bridge spoofing with exit 77
under managed membership refuse SC_DISPATCH, SC_CALLER_ROOT, SC_MEM_AS, and every ambient SC_* before target or credential inspection
only then select the canonical dispatcher and classify the public command
execution_provenance.linux: The engine wrapper forks a gated root, moves it into a non-delegated cgroup-v2 domain before release, seals the exact binding snapshot into inherited FD 198, and remains live in the Host -> issuer -> root lineage until bounded teardown. Pass = the verifier proves descriptor/cgroup identity, live lineage, generations, expiry, protected admission, and empty subtree delegation without an ambient selector.

production_linux_contributor.entry: Wrap only a complete registry-current ToolExecution identity. Refuse partial, stale, copied, wrong-domain, dead-issuer, self-created, and self-entered evidence before user code.
production_linux_contributor.teardown: Drain or cgroup.kill the one execution domain within two seconds, remove it, and surface incomplete cleanup as failure.

prototype_issuer_fixture.authority: deterministic test-only signer; never a product authority source

execution_provenance.preparation_boundary: Keep the deterministic prototype issuer in tests only. Production MUST use the live v3 producer; task 650 consumes its fixed FD/kernel context and MUST NOT wire the prototype or an ambient fallback.

preparation_policy_harness.neutral_route: help|-h|--help resolves at the stable sc admission boundary without identity lookup, credential/API/DB access, discovery, filesystem mutation, subprocess start, or authority-bearing output
preparation_policy_harness.authorized_route: mem resolves one frozen identity context only after complete aliases, stable owner-only nonsymlink credential/current-record files, current generations, literal loopback API, and authenticated whoami equality
preparation_policy_harness.effect_order: the authenticated whoami observer proves the protected-effect sentinel is absent before replying; the harness writes the exact immutable identity receipt only after stable-file rechecks
preparation_policy_harness.production_wiring: task 650 wires the stable sc bootstrap to the live v3 descriptor verifier before ambient SC selectors, dispatcher selection, policy-specific imports, credential discovery, or command effects

execution_provenance.platform_boundary: Arch and Ubuntu Linux only; the disposable Arch VM is the sole clean-room platform gate, and native Windows/macOS contributors, runners, compatibility layers, and CI are excluded
execution_provenance.executor_rule: on supported Linux, the dedicated subprocess wrapper places every Bash and pwsh foreground/background ToolExecution child in exactly one registered execution domain before user code starts
execution_provenance.managed_rule: domain membership selects DSH policy even when DSH_SHELL and every DSH_SC_* alias were deleted or falsified
execution_provenance.native_rule: no domain plus no DSH_* bridge names selects the unchanged native path
execution_provenance.spoof_rule: no domain plus any DSH_SHELL or DSH_SC_* name exits 77 before effect
execution_provenance.unknown_rule: missing, ambiguous, stale, breakaway, or unreadable domain evidence exits 77 before effect
execution_provenance.admin_artifact_rule: managed, spoofed, and unknown decisions never inspect runtime credential artifacts or attempt Admin discovery

containment_baseline.global_identity_lease: the existing DeepSeekAdapter ShellIdentityLease and managed queue remain authoritative until a separately reviewed retirement change
containment_baseline.ambient_boundary: ordinary SC_* currently survives the upstream DSH scrub, so it is poisoned in fixtures and is never accepted as DSH bridge authority
containment_baseline.proof_authority: candidate or promoted proof authority may come only from a server-minted exact-ref capability used by the dedicated promotion runner; environment, profile, request, prompt, Sprint role, persisted default, and ordinary sc calls always refuse selection

ambient_sc_policy.classification: ambient values are refused before protected effect under managed DSH; trusted values may be derived only after the guard

bounded_audit_scope.rule: exact-base direct consumer/effect audit sample only; public-route and pre-guard selector policy is exhaustive, but no route-to-callsite or whole-program reachability claim is made
